carriers.name: Concord Interstellar Freight
carriers.reputation: Predictable, bureaucratic and usually on time.
carriers.relationship_to_independents: Competes poorly for odd freight and small destinations, creating room for owner-operators.

carriers.name: Sol Transit Combined
carriers.reputation: Enormous buying power and little interest in cargo that does not fit standardized network flows.

carriers.name: Stonehaul
carriers.fleet_style: Heavy Kesh bulk and hazardous carriers.
carriers.reputation: Expensive but trusted with difficult industrial freight.

carriers.name: Bluewater Logistics
carriers.reputation: Strong Vey/Pelagos/Tidemark network and unusually good biological cargo handling.

carriers.name: Meridian Outbound
carriers.fleet_style: Mixed older ships configured for frontier freight.
carriers.reputation: Will quote routes larger carriers refuse, but prices risk accordingly.

carriers.name: Redline Independent Cooperative
carriers.fleet_style: No common fleet; independent captains share dispatch, insurance and backhaul information.
carriers.reputation: Half freight network, half argument conducted over radio and message boards.
